title: Raiders of the Apocalypse
description:
RAID. SCAVENGE. ESCAPE.Ever dreamed of rummaging through dusty bunkers filled with questionable air, hungry mutants, and half-clothed survivors who desperately want your last can of beans? Then welcome to Raiders of the Apocalypse, where oxygen is precious, common sense is overrated, and every trip is a frantic race against that ticking watch on your wrist.

SCAVENGE & SURVIVESuit up and explore procedurally generated floors in singleplayer or team up with friends. Pry open locked rooms in search of supplies, weapons, and the occasional terrified stranger. Tread carefully—hostile mutants lurk in the corridors, ready to make you question your life choices. Hurry back before your oxygen gauge dips too low… or things get messy fast.

YOUR HOME BUNKERExpand and improve your own bunker between expeditions. Smash down walls, clear the rubble, and build up your space to store your ever-growing stash of loot. Invest your hard-won Recyclable Materials at the worktable to reproduce valuable gear, then pop a floppy disk into the PC to set your next destination—going deeper means bigger risks, but the rewards might just be worth it.

WANT MORE? FIND IT IN THE RUINSThe deeper you go, the better the loot—and the bigger the danger. With each descent, you’ll face darker halls, more cunning foes, and cryptic clues about the broken world you call home. So grab your sledgehammer, pack enough snacks, and pray that your flashlight doesn’t go out at the worst possible moment. Good luck out there!
description_short: Explore dangerous bunkers packed with mutants, scavenge vital loot, and race against dwindling oxygen. Upgrade your shelter, craft gear, and risk it all for bigger rewards. Solo or co-op, see how deep you dare go!
